name: Camping 101: Fishing
summary: In Elwynn Forest, novice anglers seek ways to make camp life more comfortable. Near Goldshire, fishing expert Lee Brown teaches travelers how angling can add simple comforts to a campsite.

sections.title: Campcraft for Anglers
sections.body: Fishing gives you food, but camp life asks for more than food and shelter. A fish bowl can bring comfort and lift the spirits of weary travelers between excursions. Sound minds and high spirits help make formidable fighters.

sections.title: Lee Brown's Expertise
sections.body: Lee Brown waits beside the waters outside Goldshire to help novice fishermen broaden their craft. Travelers who show skill with rod and line can learn how simple catches and basic materials become useful additions to a campsite.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Lee Brown near Goldshire directs aspiring fishermen. After you show basic skill at fishing, he teaches you to craft camp items such as a fish bowl for roadside campsites.
Lee Brown is a fishing trainer beside Crystal Lake, just outside Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He teaches angling and how to make campcraft items for fishermen.

faq.q: What does a Fish Bowl do for a campsite?
faq.answer: A fish bowl brings comfort and joy to a campsite. Pleasant surroundings lift morale and help adventurers feel ready and capable when facing the wilderness.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The training takes place in Elwynn Forest, by the waters around Goldshire where local anglers gather.

faq.q: Do I need prior skill in fishing to complete this?
faq.answer: Yes. Lee Brown teaches travelers who have practiced casting and shown basic skill at fishing.
Yes. A well-kept camp offers comfort that improves an adventurer's physical and mental preparedness, resilience, and effectiveness in combat in the field.

angles.text: As a human traveler starting out in Elwynn Forest, you can learn wilderness self-sufficiency beside the familiar waters of Goldshire.
